summary: CrossReader(quant='int8') raised StopIteration on torch 2.15.0+cpu because supported_engines returned ['onednn'].
root_cause: next(e for e in ('fbgemm', 'x86', 'qnnpack') if e in eng) lacked onednn and fallback.

summary: Standalone run_read raised ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'src.planck3.harness' when ../sgs was absent.
root_cause: planck_vendor/src/planck3/chat.py imported .harness which had not been copied during initial vendoring.

summary: uv pip install refused to install packages into copied standalone Python due to EXTERNALLY-MANAGED marker.
root_cause: python-build-standalone managed Python includes EXTERNALLY-MANAGED by default.

summary: _resolve_ready_cloud_model queried cloud_models_cache_<pid> instead of cloud_models_<pid>.
root_cause: Meta key name mismatch between _get_cached_or_discover_models and fallback lookup.

summary: Chat on macOS raised ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'httpx' when using ../sgs/.venv via settings.json override.
root_cause: Older macOS dev venv lacked httpx listed in sidecar/requirements-runtime.txt while bundled python-runtime had it.

summary: Newly packaged satz.app bypassed bundled Contents/Resources/python-runtime and ran repo sidecar/ via ../sgs/.venv.
root_cause: Pre-existing python and repo_root keys in ~/Library/Application Support/com.satz.browser/settings.json take highest precedence over bundled resources.

summary: scripts/build_preview.sh built satz.app and satz_0.5.0_aarch64.dmg (521 MB) cleanly, then errored signing updater artifacts.
root_cause: tauri.bundle.conf.json sets createUpdaterArtifacts=true while ~/.tauri/satz.key (TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY) only existed on the Windows box and GitHub CI releases have not run yet.

summary: run_read called get_source_text() and live-fetched the source URL even when caller supplied hydrated src['text'].
root_cause: get_source_text() ran before checking src.get('text'), and confidence metadata shared the cited sentence causing false check_citations flags.

summary: test_custom_override_preserved_and_app_wide_across_profiles failed on macOS (/private/var/folders vs /var/folders).
root_cause: SatzSidecarRuntime resolves legacy_store_path while tempfile.mkdtemp() path in test_i18n.py was not resolved; ci.yml omitted Python sidecar tests on macos-latest.

summary: Adhoc-signed python-runtime/bin/python3.12 failed create_profile with macOS Keychain PasswordSetError (-25244 Invalid attempt to change the owner of this item).
root_cause: Unmocked unit tests and dev builds wrote keychain entries under PSF-signed Python that adhoc bundled binaries could not overwrite, and _get_device_key had no fallback account or SATZ_MEMORY_KEYRING=1 test mode.

summary: ./scripts/build_preview.sh failed with permission denied on macOS after being committed from Windows with mode 100644.
root_cause: Windows commits strip POSIX executable bits unless git update-index --chmod=+x is enforced in pre_commit_dev_sync.py.

summary: v0.5.1 shipped from Windows while release_gate.py failed on Mac (../sgs/.venv lacked PIL; ci.yml skipped Python sidecar tests; release_gate.py skipped test_telemetry/test_dev_brain/staged -I smoke test).
root_cause: Dual-OS CI only checked Node/Rust/security_audit without Python sidecar tests or runtime import verification.

summary: Windows CI test_hosted_sync_uploader_and_http_endpoints failed cleanup with PermissionError [WinError 32] on mail.sqlite.
root_cause: SatzSidecarRuntime.close() called non-existent mail._close_active_connection() under a broad try/except, leaving SQLite WAL handles open on Windows when TemporaryDirectory exited.

summary: Windows CI test_wire_family_collapse_and_conditional_rss returned 7 stories instead of 1 after 49s.
root_cause: SatzSidecarRuntime started _news_sync_loop unconditionally with a 12s initial wait, causing slow Windows CI runs to fetch live starter RSS feeds mid-test.

summary: Both macOS and Windows CI failed test_source_list_30_percent_cap_and_conflict_badge with 223 < 240.
root_cause: Test hardcoded >= 240 assuming ../sgs/config/planck3/source_trust.json existed, whereas standalone CI checkouts bundle 223 sources without ../sgs.

summary: Windows CI test_http_export_and_sse_import_endpoints timed out waiting on SSE response from POST /profile/import.
root_cause: SSE queue reader blocked without comment heartbeats during slow Windows Argon2id/SQLite steps, exceeding the 15s test socket timeout.
